# Daniel 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** In-the-first year of-Belshazzar king-of Babylon, Daniel saw a-dream and-visions-of his-head upon his-bed. Then he-wrote-down the-dream; the-sum-of the-matters he-told.

**2** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**3** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**4** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**5** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**6** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**7** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**8** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**9** "I-watched until thrones were-placed, and-[the]-Ancient-of-Days took-His-seat; His-garment [was] white as-snow, and-the-hair-of His-head like-pure wool; His-throne [was]-flames-of fire, its-wheels blazing fire.

**10** A-river-of fire was-flowing and-coming-forth from-before-Him; a-thousand thousands served-Him, and-ten-thousand ten-thousands stood before-Him; the-court sat, and-[the]-books were-opened.

**11** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**12** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**13** "I-was-watching in-the-visions-of the-night, and-behold, with-the-clouds-of heaven, one-like a-son-of-man was-coming, and-to the-Ancient-of-Days he-came, and-before-Him he-was-brought.

**14** And-to-him was-given dominion and-glory and-a-kingdom, that-all the-peoples, the-nations, and-the-languages should-serve-him; his-dominion [is] an-everlasting dominion which will-not-pass-away, and-his-kingdom [one] which will-not-be-destroyed."

**15** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**16** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**17** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**18** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**19** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**20** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**21** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**22** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**23** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**24** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**25** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**26** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

**27** "And-the-kingdom and-the-dominion and-the-greatness-of the-kingdoms under all the-heavens shall-be-given to-the-people-of the-saints-of the-Most-High; His-kingdom [is] an-everlasting kingdom, and-all dominions shall-serve and-obey Him."

**28** And-Daniel spoke concerning four beasts and Son of Man in-the-vision from-God.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **7:1**: Opening formula for the four beasts and Son of Man passage. Daniel's visions bridge Hebrew and Aramaic literary traditions.

- **7:14**: Central to the Ancient of Days theme — Daniel's apocalyptic imagery draws on both Mesopotamian and Israelite traditions.

- **7:28**: Closing formula — the vision concludes with Daniel's response to divine revelation.

— EMET
